_nota: World English Bible (Catholic), revisada por CatolicAid para la lectura litúrgica: SOLO introducciones (_inicios, como el leccionario) y, si la lectura empieza en mitad de un discurso, sin la conjunción inicial (For/But). Las comillas se equilibran solas (evangelio.equilibrar_comillas). Nunca se cambia el sentido.

_inicios.21:12: At that time, Jesus said to his disciples:

17.7: “Who is there among you, having a servant plowing or keeping sheep, that will say when he comes in from the field, ‘Come immediately and sit down at the table’?

21.12: “Before all these things, they will lay their hands on you and will persecute you, delivering you up to synagogues and prisons, bringing you before kings and governors for my name’s sake.
